{{Otheruses|Brotherhood}}
'''Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood Guildhouses''' were located throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though they were not as prevalent as [[Corellian Merchants' Guildhouse]]s. They provided trade contacts, information services, and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance services to members of the [[Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood/Legends|Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood]] at rates of ninety percent of the local price.<ref name="Fragments from the Rim">[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]</ref>
